_comment: Mutation testing for the governance-critical core (ADR-163). This is the
systematic form of the 2026-08-03 audit's hand-check: it edits production code
(&& -> ||, > -> >=, returns -> null) and reports every mutant NO test noticed.
A surviving mutant is a test-suite blind spot on the exact line it mutated —
which is what coverage percentages cannot tell you.
Deliberately NOT part of `pnpm test`. Every mutant re-runs the whole core suite,
so this is minutes-to-tens-of-minutes work: run it on a schedule or before
touching the pipeline, never in the inner loop. `incremental: true` means a
re-run only re-tests mutants whose code actually changed.
`mutate` is scoped to the enforcement path — the taint sink map (ADR-161), the
policy/authority evaluators, and the governed pipeline. Those are the files where
a silent test gap is a security gap. Widen only with a reason to.
